comments.text: listen ,you can eat cheap, but you have to think smart.. pork chops are cheap, you can buy a 10 lb bag of quarter chicken legs for 8 bucks, you can buy off bran veggies for a buck and change per bag, you can buy something like flat iron steaks or london broii , if u want beans or potatos as side dishes its cheap, rice is cheap and the examples i gave are rather healthy foods, stop buy foods with tons of ingredients , i can get eggs for 2 bucks a dozen , i can make 2 meals a day for under 10 bucks with 2 sides, all i am saying is i can eat well for 80 bucks a week ....stop supporting these companys jacking up prices, i refuse to pay 7 bucks for chips ,if i want junk food like chips ill go to aldis and pay 1.79 for potato chips,
